title: Veterinário Atendente
description:
Zoetis values and supports inclusion, and is committed to equal opportunities.

Location: Paulínia (SP)

Position Summary:
Responsible for upholding the highest standards of ethical care and welfare for research subjects at the Zoetis Research Center in Paulínia, ensuring full compliance with all company policies as well as relevant local and international regulations and legislation concerning research practices. Additional responsibilities include supporting in vivo studies, training colleagues, and providing backup in related procedures. The role also involves establishing and monitoring key welfare and care metrics across the research operations.

Responsibilities:

  • In collaboration with area management, develop and maintain a high-quality care program to promote health, wellbeing, and regulatory compliance for research activities at the Paulínia site. Focus areas include: disease prevention, biosafety, sanitation, pest control, management practices, safe handling protocols, responsible medication use and storage, and humane endpoints.
  • Perform daily rounds throughout the site to conduct veterinary inspections, ensuring optimal welfare conditions and that teams adhere to established procedures.
  • Maintain comprehensive records for research subjects to ensure traceability and documentation of medical history.
  • Guarantee ready access to controlled and non-controlled medications for research needs.
  • In collaboration with CEUA, expand and apply knowledge regarding local regulations and Zoetis internal standards to support accreditation and sustain best practice requirements.
  • Ensure complete alignment with Zoetis policies and the laws and guidelines of relevant authorities such as CONCEA, MAPA, CRMV, and others.
  • Actively participate in committee meetings and protocol reviews, sharing relevant updates and decisions with site teams in partnership with area leadership.
  • Report and communicate any events or concerns related to research subjects according to internal protocols and external regulations, updating the global team and implementing preventive measures as needed.
  • Provide technical expertise in veterinary science to support Zoetis and VMRD objectives, meeting client needs and contributing to collaborative scientific and service outcomes.
  • Apply scientific principles and practices to the development of tools and technologies that advance research models for drug discovery and development.
  • Collaborate with project teams to support research initiatives, including protocol and model development.
  • Foster communication between VMRD and GMS, serving as a role model for the broader Zoetis organization and presenting results internally and externally.
  • Train, educate, and guide colleagues in best practices regarding clinical procedures, research handling, care, and experiment-related workflows.
  • Identify opportunities for continuous improvement, emphasizing the principles of the 3Rs wherever possible.
  • Serve as the representative of the Paulínia site on the Zoetis Global Animal Welfare Committee.
  • As part of contingency planning, support in vivo research activities when needed.
  • Proactively prevent unsafe practices by following established safety guidelines and ensuring proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE).
  • Maintain strict confidentiality regarding sensitive information.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Veterinary Medicine, with an active CRMV license for at least 5 years.
  • Previous technical experience with the facility's working species—poultry and rodents—is desirable.
  • Solidf experience in animal facilities or in the animal health products industry is preferred.
  • Advanced English proficiency.
  • A master's or phD degree is desirable to provide additional technical support to the research team.
  • Planning and organizational skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a team
  • Knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Laboratory Practices (GLP) principles
  • Strong interpersonal skills to ensure positive relationships with colleagues from other departments
  • In-depth knowledge of animal welfare and relevant regulations
  • Activities are primarily concentrated at the animal facility located in Paulínia.
  • Work is preferably performed while standing, and requires moving between multiple buildings within the facility. Access to each building that houses different species must be performed according to established standard procedures, including changing clothes, showering, and other relevant protocols.
  • The employee must be willing to work weekends and outside of regular hours as required, according to on-call schedules and veterinary occurrences.
  • The collaborator must also be available for activities outside the Paulínia site, such as meetings at Zoetis units in Campinas and/or São Paulo, visits to service providers and suppliers, as well as participation in events related to the field.
Full time

A TrustedData está contratando um(a) Assistente Administrativo Operacional para apoiar as operações de instalação e obras, garantindo organização, conformidade documental, mobilização de equipes e eficiência nos processos. Essa é uma posição estratégica para dar suporte às equipes de campo e ao escritório, contribuindo para a fluidez das entregas.

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES:

  • Controlar e atualizar documentação de técnicos e prestadores (certificados, exames médicos, treinamentos, etc.);
  • Realizar cadastros e manter atualizações em portais de clientes e fornecedores;
  • Organizar processos de homologação de equipes para obras;
  • Planejar e apoiar mobilizações de pessoal (passagens, hospedagem, transporte, alimentação);
  • Controlar benefícios, frequência e apontamento de horas da equipe técnica;
  • Realizar atendimento e comunicação entre escritório e equipes de campo;
  • Organizar arquivos físicos e digitais de projetos;
  • Apoiar na preparação e gestão de contratos (vigência, prazos, aditivos, medições e documentação para faturamento).

REQUISITOS:

  • Ensino superior completo ou cursando (preferencialmente Administração, RH ou áreas correlatas);
  • Experiência prévia em atividades administrativas será um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento/experiência em Segurança do Trabalho será valorizado;
  • Conhecimento do sistema Cesmit será um diferencial.

PERFIL COMPORTAMENTAL:

  • Dinâmico, proativo e enérgico;
  • Rápido aprendizado e capacidade de atuar em múltiplas tarefas;
  • Ótima comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal (contato com clientes e diversas áreas internas);
  • Organização, responsabilidade e comprometimento.

Regime de trabalho: CLT, 100% presencial.

Horário de Trabalho: De segunda a sexta feira das 09:00 as 18:00 - com 1 hora de almoço.

SALÁRIO: Entre R$2.000,00 e R$2.500,00.

BENEFÍCIOS:

  • Vale refeição de R$ 605,00 por mês;
  • Convênio médico (com coparticipação);
  • Vale transporte.

title: Cientista de Dados Sênior
description:
Sobre nós

Somos orgulhosamente brasileiros e populares, digitais sempre e presenciais quando o cliente quiser. Inovamos para dar acesso a serviços financeiros e oferecemos uma experiência que encoraja as pessoas a vencerem o hoje. Nossa razão de existir é clara: lutar por uma experiência bancária que acolhe e encoraja todos os brasileiros. E fazemos isso com disponibilidade, acolhimento e agilidade. 

Nossa cultura, O Jeito Agi

Viver pelo cliente
Nosso principal ativo são os clientes. A empresa só existe se conseguir resolver suas dores, entregando produtos e experiências melhores que alternativas disponíveis no mercado. 

Agir como empreendedor
Quantas empresas você conhece que cobram espírito de dono do time? Muitas, né? Mas quantas delas possibilitam que as pessoas sejam de fato donas? E não se trata de dar essa oportunidade para poucos, mas de tornar isso possível para todos. No Agibank é assim, então aqui você age como dono porque já é dono ou porque sonha em ser o próximo.

Crescer na jornada
Nossa cultura é forte. Então, só faz sentido empreender aqui caso você se identifique muito com ela. Se você é uma pessoa fanática por resultado, tem pavor de zona de conforto, vive em eterna busca por conhecimento, prefere as coisas ditas direto ao ponto e quer estar rodeada de pessoas que também são assim, você vai curtir muito sua jornada aqui.


Modelo de trabalho 
Presencial
• Campinas/SP 
Nosso time de Dados

São os times responsáveis por definir quando a contratação de um crédito será boa para o cliente e para o Agibank, buscando o sucesso e sustentabilidade de ambos no longo prazo. Apoiam ativamente a prevenção de fraudes, com estratégias inteligentes. O time de Dados, utilizando tecnologia e visão de futuro, sustenta decisões assertivas e eficientes.

Seus desafios para crescer na jornada


  • Desenvolver, implementar e monitorar modelos estatísticos e de machine learning para resolver complexos e com impacto para o negócio.
  • Realizar exploração, limpeza e preparação de dados para estudos analíticos.
  • Criar relatórios que traduzam resultados técnicos em insights para as áreas de negócio.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para formular hipóteses, entender as necessidades, avaliar a aplicação dos modelos nas estratégias, testar soluções e acompanhar resultados.
  • Garantir a qualidade, integridade e governança dos dados utilizados nos projetos analíticos.

    • O que você precisa para se tornar um Agilizado? 


    Requisitos

  • Experiência com linguagens de programação como Python ou R.
  • Domínio de algoritmos clássicos e modernos de aprendizado de máquina, como árvores de decisão, regressão logística, ensemble e boosting models (ex.: XGBoost, LightGBM, catboost)
  • Forte base em estatística, probabilidade e modelagem preditiva.
  • Vivência com manipulação e tratamento de grandes volumes de dados (SQL, spark).

    • Diferenciais 

  • Experiência em ambientes de cloud computing (AWS, GCP ou Azure).
  • Conhecimento de modelagem de crédito (indicadores, estratégias, técnicas).
  • Experiência com modelos de risco de crédito (PD, LGD, EAD).
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de visualização (Power BI, Tableau ou similares).
  • Conhecimento em práticas de MLOps e deploy de modelos em produção.
  • Experiência ou interesse em projetos de IA generativa, NLP (Processamento de Linguagem Natural) ou modelos de grandes linguagens (LLMs).
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de versionamento de código (Git) e integração contínua.

    • Benefícios e facilidades


  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, teleatendimento psicológico e médico gratuito, Totalpass, Vale-refeição e alimentação e Seguro de vida/auxílio-funeral;
  • Maternidade e paternidade: auxílio-creche, licença-maternidade de 6 meses, licença-paternidade de 20 dias, VA/VR no período da licença;
  •  Previdência privada;
  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados (PPR) seguindo as regras estabelecidas anualmente;
  • Vale-transporte;
  • Fretado de ida e volta para Campinas e região (com raio de até 50 km de distância). São lugares reserváveis mediante a disponibilidade de assentos e rota. Para quem vai de carro, temos estacionamento gratuito;
  • Folga de presente no mês do seu aniversário;
  • Dinheiro de volta no Cartão de Crédito​: 1% de cashback sobre o valor total da fatura do cartão ​revertido em crédito na fatura seguinte;​​
  • Conta remunerada​: CDB de aplicação automática e rendimento de 100% do CDI;​​
  • Isenção de Tarifas de Comunicação Digital;​​
  • Credito do Trabalhador​: taxa e prazo diferenciados. Disponível para ​contratação a partir de 6 meses de casa;​​
  • Antecipação Saque aniversário do FGTS;
  • Dr. Pet: possibilidade fazer plano de saúde para pets com até 20% de desconto.

    • Programa Tô de dono

    O Tô de Dono é mais do que um programa de incentivo a longo prazo – ele é o reconhecimento de quem vive diariamente a nossa cultura. A cada ano, o Programa tem novos participantes, colaboradores que se tornam donos do negócio e ganham com a valorização do Agibank sempre que a empresa cresce.  Então, quem faz parte dessa história é quem mergulha de cabeça nos desafios para entregar grandes resultados. É assim que construímos, verdadeiramente, uma cultura de donos. Aqui, a fórmula é simples: você cresce. O Agibank cresce com você.

    Saiba mais sobre nosso dia a dia no LinkedIn e Youtube.

title: Mid-Level Data Analyst
description:
About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world's top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we're number one or two in many of the world's top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

What you'll do:

  • Develop and maintain a deep understanding of dashboards and KPIs creation, leveraging your knowledge of SQL
  • Analyze data to identify the best approach for building dashboards and defining relevant KPIs
  • Identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities within data — not just report what happened, but explain why it happened and what actions should follow
  • Design visually appealing and intuitive dashboards that effectively communicate analysis and insights
  • Go beyond descriptive analytics to provide actionable recommendations that drive decision-making
  • Challenge assumptions and bring a critical, investigative mindset to every analysis
  • Communicate findings, insights, and recommendations to stakeholders across the organization

What you'll need:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in engineering, marketing, statistics, economics, or a related data field
  • Experience in analytics, with a focus on dashboard creation and KPI development
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience using data visualization tools such as Power BI or others
  • Experience with statistical analysis and experimental design
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and influence stakeholders
  • Demonstrated ability to translate  data into clear business narratives and strategic recommendations
  • Excellent communication skills in English (written and spoken).

The ideal candidate for this role:

  • Combines advanced analytical and modeling skills with a keen eye for dashboard creation and insights
  • Is not just a report builder, but a strategic partner who uses data to tell stories and influence business outcomes
  • Takes ownership of finding the "why" behind the numbers and proactively surfaces insights without being asked

Nosso time de Crédito e Dados

São os times responsáveis por definir quando a contratação de um crédito será boa para o cliente e para o Agibank, buscando o sucesso e sustentabilidade de ambos no longo prazo. Apoiam ativamente a prevenção de fraudes, com estratégias inteligentes. O time de Dados, utilizando tecnologia e visão de futuro, sustenta decisões assertivas e eficientes.

Seus desafios para crescer na jornada 


  • Coordenar e orientar tecnicamente o time responsável por análises quantitativas e modelagem de Perda Esperada, aplicando técnicas estatísticas e computacionais;
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento, revisão e evolução de modelos estatísticos e preditivos de crédito (PD, LGD e EAD/CCF);
  • Conduzir e supervisionar análises ad hoc para suporte a decisões de risco, negócio e contabilidade;
  • Garantir a estruturação, coleta, tratamento e qualidade das bases de dados utilizadas para fins analíticos e regulatórios;
  • Planejar e acompanhar backtesting, monitoramento e recalibração dos modelos de Perda Esperada;
  • Preparar e revisar materiais técnicos e executivos, apresentando resultados de análises e impactos para fóruns de gestão, risco e auditoria;
  • Atuar na governança dos modelos, assegurando documentação adequada e atendimento a auditorias internas, externas e demandas regulatórias;
  • Apoiar a integração dos modelos aos processos e sistemas produtivos, garantindo consistência entre metodologia, execução e uso nas decisões.

    • O que você precisa para se tornar um Agilizado? 


    Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo em Estatística, Matemática, Física, Ciências Atuariais ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência com modelagem de crédito regulatória, especialmente Perda Esperada (PD, LGD, EAD/CCF);
  • Conhecimento de IFRS 9 e/ou Resolução Bacen nº 4.966;
  • Domínio das linguagens R e SQL;
  • Conhecimento sólido do processo e da metodologia de Modelagem Preditiva de Crédito;
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Excel;

    • Diferenciais 

  • Experiência prévia em coordenação técnica ou liderança de projetos/equipes analíticas.
  • Conhecimento de produtos financeiros, com foco em crédito pessoal e crédito consignado, e do ciclo de vida do crédito;
  • Vivência com monitoramento, validação e governança de modelos;
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Experiência com GitHub, R Markdown ou ferramentas de versionamento e documentação;
  • Experiência em instituições financeiras, cooperativas de crédito ou bancos digitais.

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, teleatendimento psicológico e médico gratuito, Totalpass, Vale-refeição e alimentação e Seguro de vida/auxílio-funeral;

    O Tô de Dono é mais do que um programa de incentivo a longo prazo – ele é o reconhecimento de quem vive diariamente a nossa cultura. A cada ano, o Programa tem novos participantes, colaboradores que se tornam donos do negócio e ganham com a valorização do Agibank sempre que a empresa cresce.  Então, quem faz parte dessa história é quem mergulha de cabeça nos desafios para entregar grandes resultados. É assim que construímos, verdadeiramente, uma cultura de donos. Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória, é apaixonado por esporte, acredita no trabalho em equipe e está disposto a correr junto com os nossos clientes.

title: Veterinário Atendente
description:
Zoetis values and supports inclusion, and is committed to equal opportunities.

Location: Paulínia (SP)

Position Summary:
Responsible for upholding the highest standards of ethical care and welfare for research subjects at the Zoetis Research Center in Paulínia, ensuring full compliance with all company policies as well as relevant local and international regulations and legislation concerning research practices. Additional responsibilities include supporting in vivo studies, training colleagues, and providing backup in related procedures. The role also involves establishing and monitoring key welfare and care metrics across the research operations.

Responsibilities:

  • In collaboration with area management, develop and maintain a high-quality care program to promote health, wellbeing, and regulatory compliance for research activities at the Paulínia site. Focus areas include: disease prevention, biosafety, sanitation, pest control, management practices, safe handling protocols, responsible medication use and storage, and humane endpoints.
  • Perform daily rounds throughout the site to conduct veterinary inspections, ensuring optimal welfare conditions and that teams adhere to established procedures.
  • Maintain comprehensive records for research subjects to ensure traceability and documentation of medical history.
  • Guarantee ready access to controlled and non-controlled medications for research needs.
  • In collaboration with CEUA, expand and apply knowledge regarding local regulations and Zoetis internal standards to support accreditation and sustain best practice requirements.
  • Ensure complete alignment with Zoetis policies and the laws and guidelines of relevant authorities such as CONCEA, MAPA, CRMV, and others.
  • Actively participate in committee meetings and protocol reviews, sharing relevant updates and decisions with site teams in partnership with area leadership.
  • Report and communicate any events or concerns related to research subjects according to internal protocols and external regulations, updating the global team and implementing preventive measures as needed.
  • Provide technical expertise in veterinary science to support Zoetis and VMRD objectives, meeting client needs and contributing to collaborative scientific and service outcomes.
  • Apply scientific principles and practices to the development of tools and technologies that advance research models for drug discovery and development.
  • Collaborate with project teams to support research initiatives, including protocol and model development.
  • Foster communication between VMRD and GMS, serving as a role model for the broader Zoetis organization and presenting results internally and externally.
  • Train, educate, and guide colleagues in best practices regarding clinical procedures, research handling, care, and experiment-related workflows.
  • Identify opportunities for continuous improvement, emphasizing the principles of the 3Rs wherever possible.
  • Serve as the representative of the Paulínia site on the Zoetis Global Animal Welfare Committee.
  • As part of contingency planning, support in vivo research activities when needed.
  • Proactively prevent unsafe practices by following established safety guidelines and ensuring proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE).
  • Maintain strict confidentiality regarding sensitive information.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Veterinary Medicine, with an active CRMV license for at least 5 years.
  • Previous technical experience with the facility's working species—poultry and rodents—is desirable.
  • Solidf experience in animal facilities or in the animal health products industry is preferred.
  • Advanced English proficiency.
  • A master's or phD degree is desirable to provide additional technical support to the research team.
  • Planning and organizational skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a team
  • Knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Laboratory Practices (GLP) principles
  • Strong interpersonal skills to ensure positive relationships with colleagues from other departments
  • In-depth knowledge of animal welfare and relevant regulations
  • Activities are primarily concentrated at the animal facility located in Paulínia.
  • Work is preferably performed while standing, and requires moving between multiple buildings within the facility. Access to each building that houses different species must be performed according to established standard procedures, including changing clothes, showering, and other relevant protocols.
  • The employee must be willing to work weekends and outside of regular hours as required, according to on-call schedules and veterinary occurrences.
  • The collaborator must also be available for activities outside the Paulínia site, such as meetings at Zoetis units in Campinas and/or São Paulo, visits to service providers and suppliers, as well as participation in events related to the field.

title: Data Product Manager – FinOps
description:
Please note that this role works 100% on-site.

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world's top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we're number one or two in many of the world's top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the Role

We are hiring a Data Product Manager – FinOps to plan and execute on FinOps initiatives, partnering closely with Finance, Engineering and Commercial. This role focuses on stakeholder analysis, requirements definition, feature delivery, and dashboard execution for FinOps tools and reporting.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience working with cloud cost data, metrics, and dashboards, and is comfortable translating business and operational needs into clear, actionable product requirements.

What you'll do:

Stakeholder Analysis & Requirements Definition

  • Partner with Finance, Accounting, Engineering, and Cloud Operations to understand cost drivers and reporting needs.
  • Gather, document, and prioritize requirements for FinOps tools, datasets, and dashboards.
  • Translate financial and operational workflows into clear product and data requirements.

FinOps Tools & Dashboard Delivery

  • Own delivery of FinOps dashboards and reporting, primarily using Power BI.
  • Define KPI logic, calculations, and metric definitions in collaboration with stakeholders.
  • Partner with data engineering teams to define data models, transformations, and refresh logic.

Product Execution

  • Own feature-level delivery aligned to the leadership-defined roadmap.
  • Write clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Support backlog management, sprint planning, and delivery tracking.

Metrics, Data Quality & Governance

  • Ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability of financial and cloud cost data.
  • Reconcile metrics with Finance and Accounting stakeholders as needed.
  • Identify data quality gaps and work with engineering to resolve them.

What you'll need:

  • Years of experience in Cloud Operations, FinOps, Data Analytics, Business Analysis, or related roles.
  • Hands-on experience working with cloud cost and usage data (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Strong proficiency in Power BI, including data modeling and DAX.
  • Experience defining and working with metrics, KPIs, and dashboards.
  • Experience gathering requirements and working with cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills ( English and Portuguese ).

More about you:

  • You´re passionate about software development and knows how to ensure its quality;
  • You´re motivated by building up world class solutions that impacts millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment which uses and stimulates DevOps culture;
  • You´re creative when solving problems and is continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;
  • You have the autonomy to recognize the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.

title: Field Application Engineer
description:
Toradex is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We're powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you're interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.

Description


As an Field Application Engineer, in Developer Experience team, your mission is to remove friction for developers using Toradex solutions. You'll support developers, create technical documentation, demos, reproducible references, and automation that let customers go from prototype to production faster. You will drive our efforts to have the best technical support experience in the industry, including assisting customers through our AI-powered developer community. You'll work closely with R&D, Product and Marketing and be the voice of developers inside Toradex.

Responsibilities


Your responsibilities will include the items below:

  • Provide technical support and guidance to developers integrating Toradex System on Modules (SoMs) into their products.

  • Contribute to building the leading self-service support experience in the embedded computing industry through high-quality documentation, community interaction, AI-assisted support, and automation.
  • Help translate complex technical concepts into clear and actionable guidance for developers and engineers using Toradex hardware and software.
  • Serve as a key stakeholder in the overall user experience of Toradex products — providing feedback to internal engineering teams based on customer challenges and use cases.
  • Interact directly with customers through email, the Toradex Community Forum, and other support channels, helping resolve technical issues efficiently.
  • Identify recurring customer pain points and proactively update documentation or examples to reduce future support load.
  • Help promote and demonstrate Toradex solutions through webinars, blogs, and developer-focused technical content.

Requirements

  • Hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science.
  • Availability to work from the Toradex Office in Campinas/SP at least 4 days a week.
  • Detail-oriented and capable of managing multiple support cases and documentation tasks simultaneously.
  • Ability and passion to learn new technologies related to embedded software, hardware, and system integration.
  • Capable of working both independently and collaboratively within a cross-functional team (engineering, marketing, support).
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to analyze hardware/software integration issues.
  • Linux experience:
    • Proficient as a user or system administrator.
    • Experience with Embedded Linux development and configuration.
  • Experience developing or debugging applications for Embedded Linux devices.
  • Knowledge of hardware interfaces and how to use them on the software side, such as:
    •  GPIO, I2C, SPI, UART, MIPI-CSI, LVDS, and others.
  • Experience with Git (collaborating in multi-contributor repositories).
  • Ability to read and understand hardware schematics.
  • Knowledge of software design patterns and anti-patterns.
  • Proficient in C/C++ and Python programming languages.
  • Familiar with at least one shell scripting language (e.g. Bash).
  • Strong proficiency in English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience providing technical support to customers in a hardware/software company.
  • Previous experience in developer enablement, documentation, or customer-facing technical roles.
  • Hands-on experience with Yocto, Docker, and Driver integration.
  • Understanding of Agile development practices.
  • Exposure to AI/ML on embedded devices or related technologies.
  • Designed or debugged a PCB or embedded system professionally or as a hobby.
  • Enthusiasm for communicating technical topics in webinars, blog posts, and developer talks.

What we offer:

  • An agile and inter-cultural work environment
  • Working with latest IoT computer technology in an international environment
  • Participation in defining processes and your working environment
  • Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space and a flexible working environment
  • Opportunities for your personal development
  • Meal allowance (flash card)

Venha fazer parte do nosso time

    • Treinar novos pesquisadores, engenheiros de processos ou técnicos de fermentação nos processos Amyris, nos conceitos importantes de cada projeto, para cada molécula;
    • Utilizar ferramentas avançadas de planejamento de experimentos, DOEs, DCCRs, PBs para avaliação de efeitos isolados e sinergias de variáveis de processo sob os resultados dos diferentes experimentos conduzidos no PD;
    • Ter uma visão sistêmica de processos envolvendo múltiplas áreas (Fermentação, DSP, Qualidade, Regulatórios, Segurança) estabelecendo conexões com as áreas de interface e avaliando os processos Amyris de forma ampla.

    • Inglês avançado;
    • Conhecimento em softwares de análise estatística de dados (JMP, Minitab, Statistica);
    • Conhecimento em Microsoft Office – Word/Excel/Powerpoint;
    • Experiência em redação de relatórios técnicos, transferências de tecnologia e análises de dados/análises estatísticas geradas a partir dos diferentes experimentos conduzidos na planta piloto.

title: Chief Financial Officer
description:
POSITION OVERVIEW:

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Chief Financial Officer (CFO) who will drive the company's financial strategy to achieve breakeven and accelerate growth. This role goes beyond traditional financial management; we need someone who can develop a strategy, monitor KPIs, and provide actionable insights to optimize operations. The CFO will be responsible for securing financing, leading M&A efforts, and acting as the main point of contact with investors. This role requires a strong command of Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Financial Strategy & Hands-On Management:
- Lead and execute financial strategies to drive operational efficiency and help the company move toward breakeven.
- Oversee daily financial operations, including managing cash flow and complex accounting processes.
- Improve financial reporting to accurately reflect the companys unique value and growth potential.

KPI Monitoring & Reporting:
- Establish, monitor, and report on key financial KPIs to track the companys financial health and operational efficiency.
- Provide strategic financial insights and regular reports to the executive team and the board of directors.

Financing & Investor Relations:
- Secure hardware financing by negotiating with multiple banks and financial partners.
- Lead the company's capital-raising efforts, including equity and debt financing.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with investors, including taking the lead in defending the companys position during negotiations.
- Actively engage in M&A opportunities to align with the companys strategic objectives
- Prepare financial models, investor presentations, and ensure transparent communication with investors.

Operational Support:
- Work closely with other departments to ensure financial strategies are aligned with operational goals.
- Provide financial leadership in all major business decisions, ensuring that financial considerations are integrated into company strategy.

QUALIFICATIONS:
- Proven experience as a CFO or in a similar financial leadership role in high-growth environments, preferably in startups.
- Strong skills in Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.
- Demonstrated ability to secure financing, lead investor relations, and negotiate with financial institutions.
- Experience in M&A, capital raising, and developing financial strategies to support business growth.
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field; MBA or CPA preferred.

WHY JOIN US?
This is an opportunity to play a critical role in shaping the future of a high-potential startup that addresses one of the main challenges of our generation. If you are a strategic thinker with a hands-on approach and the drive to solve complex financial challenges, we want you on our team.

title: Environmental Technician
description:
Descrição da empresa

A Turner & Townsend é uma empresa global de serviços profissionais com mais de colaboradores em mais de 60 países. Trabalhando com nossos clientes nos setores de imobiliário, infraestrutura, energia e recursos naturais, transformamos juntos, entregando resultados que melhoram a vida das pessoas.

Trabalhamos em parceria e tornamos possível entregas dos projetos e programas mais impactantes do mundo, transformando desafios em oportunidades e complexidade em sucesso.

Nossos serviços incluem Gestão de Programas, Projetos, Custos, Ativos e Comercial, Controles e Desempenho, Compras e Cadeia de suprimentos, soluções para emissões zero e Digital.

Somos majoritariamente de propriedade do CBRE Group, Inc., a maior empresa de serviços imobiliários comerciais e investimentos do mundo, com nossos parceiros detendo uma participação minoritária significativa. Turner & Townsend e CBRE trabalham juntos para fornecer aos clientes a melhor oferta de gestão de programas, projetos e custos em mercados ao redor do mundo.

Descrição do emprego

Estamos buscando um Técnico Ambiental analítico e detalhista para se juntar à nossa equipe imobiliária em Campinas, Brasil. Nessa função, o(a) senhor(a) será responsável por realizar avaliações ambientais, monitorar a conformidade e apoiar iniciativas de desenvolvimento sustentável para nossos projetos imobiliários.

  • Realizar avaliações ambientais do local e estudos de impacto para projetos de desenvolvimento imobiliário
  • Coletar e analisar dados ambientais usando equipamentos e softwares especializados
  • Garantir a conformidade com as regulamentações ambientais locais, estaduais e federais
  • Colaborar com incorporadores imobiliários e gerentes de projeto para implementar práticas de construção sustentáveis
  • Preparar relatórios detalhados sobre descobertas e recomendações ambientais
  • Auxiliar na obtenção das licenças e certificações ambientais necessárias para projetos imobiliários
  • Monitorar e avaliar o desempenho ambiental de propriedades existentes
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de planos de gerenciamento ambiental para ativos imobiliários
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tecnologias ambientais emergentes e as melhores práticas do setor imobiliário

Qualificações

  • Bacharelado em Ciências Ambientais, Engenharia Ambiental ou em uma área relacionada
  • Experiência relevante em avaliação ambiental ou em uma área relacionada; preferencialmente, experiência no setor imobiliário
  • Proficiência no uso de equipamentos de monitoramento e teste ambiental
  • Sólidas habilidades de coleta e análise de dados
  • Conhecimento das regulamentações ambientais, especialmente as aplicáveis no Brasil
  • Experiência com software GIS e Microsoft Office Suite
  • Familiaridade com práticas de construção sustentável e processos de desenvolvimento imobiliário
  • Certificações ambientais relevantes (por exemplo, LEED, BREEAM) são uma vantagem
  • Excelente atenção aos detalhes e habilidades analíticas
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com eficiência e gerenciar vários projetos simultaneamente
  • É necessário ter fluência em português e inglês

Informações Adicionais

Nossos profissionais inspirados compartilham nossa visão e missão. Oferecemos um excelente local de trabalho, onde cada pessoa tem a oportunidade e a voz para promover mudanças.

Queremos que nossos profissionais tenham sucesso tanto no trabalho quanto na vida pessoal e por isso promovemos um ambiente de trabalho saudável, produtivo e flexível que respeita o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional.
